description.value: Bamboo Grove Restaurant is one of Richmond's oldest Chinese restaurants, established in 1963 as a coffee shop and now an award-winning Cantonese dining destination in the city's busy Number 3 Road corridor. It has earned multiple Metro Vancouver Chinese Restaurant Awards since 2010, with celebrated signature dishes including geoduck with scrambled eggs and a slow-boiled pork stomach and ginkgo soup. A touring cyclist will find a full-service sit-down restaurant serving an extensive menu of live seafood, clay pot dishes, and Cantonese classics.
